hero.title: Engineering the Autonomous Technologies of Tomorrow

Through software and hardware developed at Pamukkale University Technopark, we engineer dependable robotic systems for the future.

founder.description: Founded under the leadership of Prof. Dr. İsmail Ovalı, NCT Robotik transforms academic research and engineering experience into locally developed technology products. In 2018, Prof. Dr. Ovalı established NCT Inventors’ Workshop to help children engage with technology as creators, not merely consumers. Today, the workshop is among the leading coding education centers in the Aegean region and forms the foundation of NCT Robotik’s educational technology vision.
founder.partner1Desc: A coding and technology workshop established by Prof. Dr. İsmail Ovalı in 2018.
founder.partner2Desc: We collaborate with POLO Otomasyon in the manufacturing of our robotic systems.

fields.description: Four core fields in which NCT Robotik designs and develops robotic solutions.

card1.title: Educational Robots
card1.desc: Orbit Pix, Orbit Pro, and Orbit Lite support learning from preschool through high school, including subject review, foreign-language practice, and homework assistance. Across the product family, they also support teachers in robotics coding and subject-specific classroom activities.

card2.title: Healthcare & Care Robots

card3.title: Service & Hospitality Robots
card3.desc: Advanced service and guide robots for greeting visitors, offering directions and information, distributing brochures, and serving refreshments in restaurants, cafés, hotels, trade shows, and corporate facilities.

card4.title: Industrial & Logistics Robots
card4.desc: Our autonomous mobile robot (AMR) platforms support material and raw-material transport in factories, warehouses, and heavy-industry facilities without constant human intervention.

hero.title: How Does Orbit Pix Build a Learning Profile?
hero.description: The NCT Personalized Robotic Learning Companion Model was developed to understand each student’s unique learning journey and provide the learning experience best suited to them.

section1.title: How Is the Initial Learning Profile Created?
section1.description: We follow a multi-step, research-informed approach to getting to know each student.

step1.title: Information Is Collected from Parents
step1.desc: Information and responses to brief questions in the mobile app serve as the starting point.

step2.title: An Initial Profile Is Created
step2.desc: An initial learning profile is created for the student based on the information collected.

step3.title: Initial Interactions Are Analyzed
step3.desc: Conversations and interactions with Pix are analyzed to begin refining the profile.

section2.title: What Does Pix Take into Account?
section2.description: Pix seeks to understand the student by examining different aspects of learning.

feature1.title: Learning Preferences
feature1.desc: Preferences for visual, auditory, or example-based learning

feature3.title: Academic Needs
feature3.desc: Subject-specific strengths and areas needing support

feature4.title: Interests
feature4.desc: Topics, examples, and activities that capture their interest

feature5.title: Study Habits
feature5.desc: Attention span, study pace, and motivational factors

section3.title: How Does the Profile Evolve Over Time?
section3.description: Its dynamic structure helps Pix understand the student better over time.

monthOne.desc: The profile becomes noticeably more refined.

monthThree.desc: The profile is continuously updated, allowing greater personalization.

section4.title: What Does Personalization Influence?
section4.description: The profile helps improve the overall learning experience offered by Pix.

row1.title: Language and Delivery Style
row1.desc: Explanations tailored to the student’s level and preferences

row2.title: Selection of Examples and Content
row2.desc: Examples that match the student’s interests and needs

row3.title: Study and Practice Suggestions
row3.desc: Suggestions at the right level and the right time

row4.title: Approach to Support and Guidance
row4.desc: Motivation and support are adapted to the student

row5.title: Goal and Progress Tracking
row5.desc: Areas for improvement are identified and monitored
